jobPostingInfo.title: Intern, Frankfurt
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
3i is an investment company specialising in Private Equity and Infrastructure. We invest in mid-market companies headquartered in Europe and North America.


Our purpose

We generate attractive returns for our shareholders and co-investors by investing in private equity and infrastructure assets. As proprietary capital investors we have a long-term, responsible approach.

We aim to compound value through thoughtful origination, disciplined investment and active management of our assets, driving sustainable growth in our investment companies.

  • Support in preparing investment proposals for internal decision-making, as well as developing independent investment thesis and buy-and-build strategies for future investment opportunities.

  • Preparation of internal and external presentation materials and support with the analysis contained within them.

  • Independent development of simple operational models and financial analysis models to assess the impact of a financial sponsor on a company’s operational success.

  • Conducting market analysis of selected sectors to identify future market developments and potential add-on opportunities.

  • Research, development and evaluation of megatrends and underlying dynamics in the technology sector.

  • Preparation and analysis of financial statements, including margin analysis of potential investment opportunities and portfolio companies.

  • Preparation for and participation in calls with external advisors and industry experts.

Please register your interest in an internship by clicking Apply and providing your CV and contact details.
